snippet.title: Scars of Honor MMORPG - Gameplay Showcase Dec. 2025 | PvE, PvP, Systems & Art Direction
snippet.description:
Scars of Honor is an old-school MMORPG currently in development.
In this gameplay showcase, we’re sharing the most complete look at the game so far, including new gameplay, PvE and PvP systems, and the updated art direction.

You’ll see:

New gameplay footage
A first look at PvE content and procedural dungeons
PvP direction and core systems
Crafting, cooking, and progression systems
The game’s updated art direction
More surprises!

This is not a launch. Scars of Honor is still evolving, and this Showcase is about showing where the game is today and what we’re building toward.

If you like what you see, wishlist Scars of Honor on Steam, follow the project, and stay tuned for future updates: 
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4253010/Scars_of_Honor/ 

#ScarsOfHonor #MMORPG #MMORPGShowcase #UpcomingMMORPG
